description: Kansas’s Successful Families Program combines TANF cash assistance with employment and support services for eligible families raising children.
introduction: Kansas’s Successful Families Program combines TANF cash assistance with employment and support services for eligible families raising children.

sections.who: A family must include a child under 18, including an unborn baby under the state’s published guidance, and meet income/resource requirements. Qualifying relative or court-appointed caregivers may apply.
sections.get: Cash amounts depend on income, household size, living arrangement and county. Employment support can include training, transportation and help addressing barriers.
sections.docs: Prepare child/caregiver details, household finances and prior TANF history. Tell the worker about caregiving or health circumstances affecting work participation.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through the DCF Self-Service Portal or contact DCF Benefits Assistance at 888-369-4777 for a paper form.

  2. Complete screening and discuss work activities and child-support cooperation. DCF lists exceptions for caring for a baby under two months or a disabled household member; ask how the rule applies.
sections.after: The published lifetime limit is 24 months, with specified hardship provisions in the policy manual. Ask how previous assistance is counted. Follow reporting and participation notices.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: Successful Families eligibility, Hardship policy.

faqs: The program includes qualifying relatives and certain court-appointed caregivers.
Is the payment identical in every county?
No. County and living arrangement affect the cash table.
Work participation rules have specified exceptions; discuss your circumstances with DCF.
Is 24 months an absolute limit without exceptions?
The policy manual includes hardship provisions requiring DCF assessment.
